TRA_FAC_RES_A_7:
I feel a strange sensation deep within my brain as gravity momentarily destabilises. The electromagnetic stablisers in my Exosuit prevent any more dramatic effects.
However, power has not been restored to the terminal. If anything, it has only suffered more damage. The facility remains inoperable.
TRA_FAC_RES_B_7: A slow shiver pulses through my body as the powerful electromagnetic wave sweeps across the facility.<DELAY>0.4<> Almost immediately, the terminal screen clears up. The production facility is back online.
TRA_FAC_RES_C_7:
I throw the master power switch that sits alongside the terminal. The facility powers down. I reset the switch, and hope...
It does not power back up again.
TRA_FAC_DESC_9: The wail of an alarm fills my ears, but the system is not reacting to my intrusion. Someone else has been here and modified this terminal before. I struggle to decipher the data on the terminal.
DNT_TRA_FAC_LANG_9: Warning! Unexpected system detected! Bypass chip template detected! Gek Trade Federation informed!
TRA_FAC_DESC_9A: Whatever code has been loaded on the terminal is clearly the work of some enterprising thief. It appears to be emptying the resource vaults of rare metals.
TRA_FAC_RES_A_9: I reset the system back to its default production loadout. Things appear to be operating as expected.
TRA_FAC_RES_B_9: I attempt to perform my own hijack of the terminal. It reroutes some of the automated profit flows directly to my account. However, my intrusion is clearly not subtle enough. Anti-tampering systems react and lock me out of the terminal.
TRA_FAC_DESC_11: Despite the warnings sounding out across the facility, the terminal remains open and ready for commerce. A brief introductory message blinks on the screen.
DNT_TRA_FAC_LANG_11: Friend! Know language, know commerce! Units buy knowledge! Choose Vy'keen, choose Korvax or choose a refresher in the language of the benevolent Gek!
TRA_FAC_DESC_11A: Three columns of words endlessly scroll on-screen, each in a strange alphabet. Bloodied runes scratched in sand, a precise sequences of dots, and a hand-written font full of exclamatory punctuation.
TRA_FAC_RES_A_11: As I scan the runes, I feel a deep-seated roar rattle around my mind. A word sears itself into my brain, the language of a distant warrior race.
TRA_FAC_RES_B_11: The dots race across the screen, an elegant, dancing pattern. I settle into the rhythm, and suddenly feel a burst of comprehension.<DELAY>0.4<>A word sears itself into my brain. I feel altered by the process.
TRA_FAC_RES_C_11: I feel a chittering glee as I scan the words the terminal presents. My other senses are affected, and I feel almost as if I could smell the language. Suddenly, a word sears itself into my brain, a fragment of Gek speech.
TRA_FAC_DESC_12: Alarms echo across the facility, a warning against my intrusion. Such an alert does not appear to slow down the commercial needs of the Gek, however. A nearby trade-ship is hailing the facility, looking for goods.
DNT_TRA_FAC_LANG_12: Gek Trade Federation dispatch! Planetary metal demand high! Collection ship imminent!
TRA_FAC_DESC_12A: Perhaps if I were to offer goods of my own, I might both turn a profit and avoid alerting the Gek that there is an intruder in their facility...
TRA_FAC_RES_A_12: A relieved beaked trader shouts their thanks through the speaker systems. The success of the transaction appears to convince the security systems that I am a legitimate user.
TRA_FAC_RES_B_12: The terminal shuts down rapidly. I can only assume my reply gave me away, and the trader alerted the authorities to my intrusion.
TRA_FAC_RES_C_12:
The trade vault slams shut.

I only receive a small payment.
TRA_FAC_DESC_13: My dramatic entry appears to have caused a fire alert. The screen is wet to the touch. A warning flashes on the terminal:
DNT_TRA_FAC_LANG_13: Warning! Resource vault flooded! Production system operation forbidden!
TRA_FAC_DESC_13A: Panels in the ceiling drip where a sprinkler system has been engaged. I can only hope the liquid is water.
TRA_FAC_RES_A_13: The system sputters a little, showing signs of life. But it is not to be - a shower of sparks reveals a short-circuit within the flooded terminal. It closes down, the facility lifeless.
TRA_FAC_RES_B_13:
The drained resource vault feeds rare elements into the production system.

The facility is back online.
TRA_FAC_RES_C_13: Despite a dramatic gurgling from beneath my feet, the facility remains offline. The terminal, fatally damaged, shorts out.
TRA_FAC_DESC_14: I open the terminal, looking for a way to shut off the alarm. Primary access appears to be via some sort of hand scanner.
TRA_FAC_DESC_14A:
I place my Exosuit glove upon the indent.
Without warning, a thousand tiny needles shoot out of the reader, meshing my hand to the machine. A synthetic voice speaks to me.
DNT_TRA_FAC_LANG_14: Friend healing and repair station initializing! Please, be happy!
TRA_FAC_RES_A_14: I grab my Multi-Tool with my free hand and fire at the terminal.<DELAY>0.4<> It explodes, releasing its grip. A few shards of metal remain embedded in my fingers, but I am free.
TRA_FAC_RES_B_14: I struggled against the grip of the machine. As I pull, my hand rips free. The terminal is covered in blood.
TRA_FAC_RES_C_14:
A beautiful, clean feeling overcomes me. The terminal pumps some sort of healing fluid into my Exosuit. I feel utterly refreshed.
The process completes, and the facility accepts me as one if its own.
TRA_FAC_DESC_15: The alarm has rebooted the facility. An automated start-up routine is running. The terminal flashes text at me, clearly expecting some input.
DNT_TRA_FAC_LANG_15: Warning! Product recipe unselected! Assign recipe! Gek Trade Federation lose units!
TRA_FAC_DESC_15A: A 3D interface waits in front of me, awaiting a blueprint for the facility to mass-produce. Machines around me hum as they warm up...
TRA_FAC_RES_A_15: The terminal accepts my design and the installation start-up procedure completes. I hope the Gek who run this facility are happy with my choice.
TRA_FAC_RES_B_15: The terminal accepts my design and the installation start-up procedure completes. The Gek who run this facility may appreciate the extra green in their environment.
TRA_FAC_RES_C_15: The terminal accepts my design and the installation start-up procedure completes. I hope the Gek who run this facility are happy with their vast pile of sugar.
TRA_FAC_DESC_16: The facility's machinery lies still, halted by the emergency shutdown. A short message blinks on the control terminal.
DNT_TRA_FAC_LANG_16: User warning! Production disengaged. Restart generator empty. No fuel. Facility restart requires organic fuel.
TRA_FAC_DESC_16A: A heavy circuit control switch sits invitingly above a fuel hopper, but a nearby dial shows that the tank is empty.
TRA_FAC_RES_A_16:
I feed the fuel tank with a catalyst, hoping to boost the effect of whatever material powers this facility.
I throw the switch. <DELAY>0.66<> A low rumble is followed by a loud explosion deep within the facility. The terminal immediately cuts out.
TRA_FAC_RES_B_16:
I feed a large amount of ferrite dust into the system's fuel supply. The pipes become sticky and choked, the dust mixing with the residue of other fuels.
I throw the switch, but to no avail. The generator system splurts and coughs before shutting down completely.
TRA_FAC_RES_C_16:
The carbon-based fuel slips down the hopper's metal throat. I hear a gurgle as it feeds into the generator system.
I throw the switch. <DELAY>0.8<> The generator ticks over, then roars into life. The surge of power from the generator triggers the facility's main reactor, and the machinery comes back online.
TRA_FAC_DESC_22: An unknown fault has forced the whole system offline. There is a strange chill in the air, a sharp clarity to the atmosphere.
DNT_TRA_FAC_LANG_22: Alert! Alert! Liquid frenium leak! Charge cylinders frozen! Increase temperature!
TRA_FAC_DESC_22A: I exhale as I ponder the words on the terminal. Condensation begins to cloud my visor.
TRA_FAC_RES_A_22: Warmth spreads through the facility. The air around me remains strange to look at, but the production systems return online.
TRA_FAC_RES_B_22: The system remains frozen. If anything, the air around me becomes even icier. Strange crystals frost over the surface of the terminal as it shuts down.
TRA_FAC_RES_C_22: The noise of muffled explosions can be heard beneath my feet. The facility does become rapidly warmer, but all systems shut down dramatically.
TRA_FAC_DESC_23: Emergency measures have been initialised. The timestamp on the terminal's error reporting display shows that the incident occured long before my intrusion.
DNT_TRA_FAC_LANG_23: Electrolyte acidity test positive! Acidity slug detected! Release alkaline neutrality fluid into solution tank!
TRA_FAC_DESC_23A: A recent scan shows a small alien lifeform crushed in the machinery below. Equipment all round it has corroded.
TRA_FAC_RES_A_23:
There is a hiss as the alkaline solution floods the facility's pipes. Machinery strains, trying to break free of the blockage in the gears.
With an unsettling snap, the production facility comes back online. The remains of the lifeform must have been washed free of the mechanisms.
TRA_FAC_RES_B_23: The air takes on a curious acidic tang. Fragile wires in the terminal corrode rapidly. The display shorts out, and then shuts down entirely.
TRA_FAC_RES_C_23: A frenzied chemical reaction can be heard somewhere beneath my feet. The terminal - and the rest of the facility - shuts down entirely.
TRA_FAC_DESC_24: The terminal barks a repeated warning. Though the words are unclear, the symbol is instantly recognisable. Something, somewhere in the facility is on fire.
DNT_TRA_FAC_LANG_24: Resource vault fire detected! Element stockpile destroyed!
TRA_FAC_DESC_24A: A faint smoke begins to rise, and my scanner registers a steadily increasing temperature.
TRA_FAC_RES_A_24:
I hear a hiss as the air drains from the machinery chambers beneath my feet. The heat levels remain steady, however.
The control terminal enters an automated shutdown.
TRA_FAC_RES_B_24:
I hear a hiss as the air drains from the resource vaults beneath my feet. Slowly but surely the heat levels start to drop. The fire is under control.
Enough remains in the vault that I should be able to restore the facility to operational status.
TRA_FAC_RES_C_24: The facility sprinkler showers above my head. It has no impact on the internal fire, but does short out the control terminal.
TRA_FAC_DESC_25: My entry has caused the facility to go into immediate lockdown, interrupting its operation. Visual readouts on the terminal indicate that this is a deep-level mining facility. Its resource vaults are emptying rapidly.
DNT_TRA_FAC_LANG_25: Drilling error! Elements drain into planet core! Reverse tunnel pressure!
TRA_FAC_DESC_25A: The facility map shows flashing errors over both the resource collection vaults and the drill array...
TRA_FAC_RES_A_25: I hear a deep, distant noise, a subterranean roll of thunder. The resource vaults empty entirely, drained into the earth. The facility remains offline.
